== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Service rows "Volunteer Coordination Advocate" (Dec 2002 – Aug 2008) and "Collecting Advocate" (Aug 2008 – Feb 2017): their refs describe Howard (announced 24 October 2002 replacing John Arendt) and Garrett Larson ("deadbody"), not Colson. These rows may have been copied from another person's page; check before keeping.
=== Missing data ===
* Dates for the tournament director and Star Trek CCG Ambassador rows (Decipher profile gives only "from 1996, for almost a year" for TD work).
* Dates for the new Service rows from the 2022 BoardMatt interview (Gen Con / DecipherCon / regional events, Dragon Con card games director, PC representative visit to Norfolk); the interview gives none.
* What "FL" means on Squadron slots: printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* "Other sourced notes" section: "Gold 5 FL, Huntsville, Alabama. RFD broadcast 10 discussed Star Trek CCG in the Alabama region with Jonathan Quesenberry." (no ref; unclear whether Colson appears in the broadcast; see Radio Free Decipher).

== Advocate Service rows (2026-10-16) ==
Kept both advocate rows. [[Jim Colson]] is named on the 9 December 2002 Advocate Council page as Volunteer Coordination Advocate. The 3 August 2008 encyclopedia lists him as Prize Support Advocate (handle ShadowLeader); the 25 September 2008 volunteer page and the February 2012 About sidebar list ShadowLeader under Prize Support/Collecting. Dropped home2002 (Howard replacing Arendt), larson (Garrett Larson / deadbody), and nma2012 (Stephen Kim) from this person page; those cites are about other people. End of Collecting tenure is the February 2017 About page, which no longer lists the seat.
